# Alan Weibel

> Alan Weibel is a product designer focused on design systems and AI. For over 25 years he has designed and built software where design systems, developer experience, and enterprise platforms meet — these days, mostly for agents. He is a Product Design Architect at Salesforce and a named inventor on 40+ granted US patents.

This site is a single page: https://alanweibel.com/. Contact: alanweibel@gmail.com.

## Curriculum vitae

- Now: Product Design Architect, [Salesforce](https://www.salesforce.com/)
- Earlier: Lead Product Design, Apttus (acquired by [Conga](https://conga.com/))
- Earlier: Product and Marketing Design, Axcient (acquired by [ConnectWise](https://www.connectwise.com/))
- Earlier: Designer, Reality Digital (agency)
- Earlier: Designer, Synthesis Media (print magazine publisher)
- Patents: [Named inventor, 40+ granted US patents](https://patents.google.com/?inventor=Alan+Weibel)
- Clients (project work): Google, Disney, Nike, Visa, LinkedIn, Adobe
- Education: California State University, Chico

Focus areas: design systems, AI business transformation, AI product design, agentic and user experience, developer experience, enterprise software.
